sn35.74:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṃkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.74:1.3: amukasmiṃ bhante, vihāre aññataro bhikkhu navo appaññāto ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn35.74:1.4: sādhu bhante, bhagavā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
sn35.74:2.1: atha kho bhagavā navavādañca sutvā gilānavādañca appaññāto bhikkhūti iti viditvā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami.
sn35.74:2.2: addasā kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
sn35.74:2.5: alaṃ bhikkhu mā tvaṃ mañcena samañcosi.
sn35.74:2.8: nisajja kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
sn35.74:2.9: kacci te bhikkhu khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti, paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti?
sn35.74:3.1: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
sn35.74:4.1: kacci te bhikkhu na kiñci kukkuccaṃ, na koci vippaṭisāroti?
sn35.74:5.1: taggha me bhante, anappakaṃ kukkuccaṃ, anappako vippaṭisāroti.
sn35.74:6.1: kacci pana tvaṃ bhikkhu attā sīlato upavadatīti.
sn35.74:7.1: na kho me bhante attā sīlato upavadatīti.
sn35.74:8.1: no ce kira tvaṃ bhikkhu attā sīlato upavadati, atha kismiñca te kukkuccaṃ? ko ca vippaṭisāroti?
sn35.74:9.1: na kho ahaṃ bhante, sīlavisuddhatthaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn35.74:10.1: no ce kira tvaṃ bhikkhu sīlavisuddhatthaṃ mayā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi, atha kimatthaṃ carahi tvaṃ bhikkhu, mayā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsīti?
sn35.74:11.1: rāgavirāgatthañca khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn35.74:12.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu rāgavirāgatthaṃ mayā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi.
sn35.74:12.3: rāgavirāgattho hi bhikkhu mayā dhammo desito.
sn35.74:13.1: aniccaṃ bhante. yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti? dukkhaṃ bhante. yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi eso me attāti? no hetaṃ bhante
sn35.74:14.5: niccā vā aniccāvā ti? aniccā bhante. …pe…
sn35.74:16.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti?
sn35.74:18.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāma dhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn35.74:18.2: etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attāti?
sn35.74:20.1: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati sotasmimpi nibbindati ghānasmimpi nibbindati jivhāyapi nibbindati kāyasmimpi nibbindati manasmimpi nibbindati.
sn35.74:20.2: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.74:20.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ. kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
sn35.74:21.2: attamano so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi.
sn35.74:21.3: imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne tassa bhikkhuno virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
